case_number: Civil Appeal No. of 2023 / SLP (Civil) No. of 2023 (Diary No. 23775 of 2022)
summary: The appeals challenged the High Court of Karnataka's orders dated 20.12.2019 (dismissing appeal against trial court decree) and 15.07.2022 (dismissing review petition). The core issue was maintainability of a second Special Leave Petition after dismissal of the first with liberty to file a review in the High Court. The respondents objected that no SLP lies against a review order under Order XLVII Rule 7 CPC, and that the earlier liberty did not extend to a subsequent SLP. The Court upheld the bar under Order XLVII Rule 7, held that mere liberty to file review does not revive right to file SLP, and dismissed the appeals on grounds of maintainability without examining merits.
legal_provisions_cited: Sandhya Educational Society Vs. Union Of India (2014) 7 SCC 701
Vinod Kapoor Vs. State Of Goa (2012) 7 SCC 701
final_judgment: Appeals dismissed on grounds of maintainability.
